name: quizlet-telegram-bot
description: Telegram bot for learning vocabulary from Quizlet

scripts.start: npx prisma migrate deploy && node dist/index.js
scripts.db:backup: mkdir -p backups && docker compose exec -T db pg_dump -U postgres quizlet_bot > ./backups/latest.sql
scripts.db:restore: docker compose exec -T db psql -U postgres quizlet_bot < ./backups/latest.sql
